# Start a node

By the end of this chapter, you can ask a running OpenSearch node how it is.

## Ask the cluster's health {#ask-the-health}

The node runs beside your terminal, on port 9200 of your own machine. Ask it how the cluster is: one node, and every
primary shard assigned.

[Step: cluster-health](../examples/cluster-health.sh)

[Check: node-answers](../examples/node-answers.sh)
